      • readCsvWithSchema

        public tech.tablesaw.api.Table readCsvWithSchema(Path csvPath,
                                                 String[] expectedCols,
                                                 tech.tablesaw.api.ColumnType[] expectedTypes,
                                                 boolean allowSuperset)
                                          throws IOException
        Reads a CSV file into a Table with a known schema and validates its header and types.

        This implementation uses a two-step import process:

        1. Read the CSV with all columns forced to STRING.
        2. Normalize boolean values and convert types according to the schema.

        This avoids Tablesaw’s strict Boolean parser rejecting values such as "true", "false", "yes", "no", "1", "0", etc.

        Parameters:
        csvPath - path to the CSV file
        expectedCols - expected column names in order
        expectedTypes - expected column types in order
        allowSuperset - if true, allows the CSV to contain extra columns
        Returns:
        a typed, schema-validated Table
        Throws:
        IOException - if the CSV is missing, invalid, or fails validation
